tools.name: search_commanders
tools.description: Find Commander candidates by name. Returns the best validated commander match and other autocomplete results.

tools.name: build_mana_base
tools.description: Generate a 30–42 land Commander mana base within a USD purchase budget of at least $20. Supports owned, locked, and excluded lands, limited upgrades, optional acceleration, and an optional TCGplayer cart.

tools.name: plan_collection
tools.description: Plan upgrades for 2–3 Commander decks in priority order with a shared inventory and USD purchase budget. Returns allocation, proposed swaps, and an optional cart. Supports fresh inputs, a portable backup, or restoration by private plan ID.

tools.name: list_collection_plans
tools.description: List private plan names, IDs, and revisions for the signed-in Landfiller account.

tools.name: save_collection_plan
tools.description: Create or update a private collection plan for the signed-in Landfiller account. Updates replace the saved inputs and require the current plan ID and revision.

tools.name: delete_collection_plan
tools.description: Delete a private saved plan by ID and current revision for the signed-in Landfiller account.

tools.name: upgrade_precon
tools.description: Upgrade a Commander precon for a Commander deck within a USD budget. Accepts a quantity-prefixed decklist or a supported public deck URL. Returns proposed swaps, role counts, warnings, estimated costs, and optional TCGplayer links.

tools.name: reduce_deck_cost
tools.description: Find lower-cost deck replacements for a Commander deck within a USD budget. Accepts a quantity-prefixed decklist or a supported public deck URL. Returns proposed swaps, role counts, warnings, estimated costs, and optional TCGplayer links.

tools.name: repair_deck
tools.description: Repair deck roles and consistency for a Commander deck within a USD budget. Accepts a quantity-prefixed decklist or a supported public deck URL. Returns proposed swaps, role counts, warnings, estimated costs, and optional TCGplayer links.

tools.name: change_deck_bracket
tools.description: Review a Commander bracket transition for a Commander deck within a USD budget. Accepts a quantity-prefixed decklist or a supported public deck URL. Returns proposed swaps, role counts, warnings, estimated costs, and optional TCGplayer links.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search Commander-legal paper cards by name, role, or Scryfall syntax. Supports color identity, mana value, card type, price, and commander interaction filters. Returns rules text, estimated prices, and optional TCGplayer links.

tools.name: import_deck
tools.description: Import a public HTTPS Commander deck URL as deck text, card count, and warnings. Archidekt Deck API: https://archidekt.com/forum/thread/16962481. Moxfield API access (private): https://moxfield.com/help/help-articles/faq#moxfield-api.

tools.name: find_replacements
tools.description: Suggest at most one replacement for a named card in a Commander deck. Accepts deck text or a supported public deck URL and checks budget, legality, ownership, protected cards, and exclusions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
